## What's new in 0.6.0

- Experimental PlayStation Vita homebrew port, including MP3 music replacements and bundled mods.
- Episode 1 data and mod assets are included in the Vita VPK.
- No Android changes in this release; the latest Android build remains v0.5.0.

## Downloads

- **Windows x64** · Unpack the ZIP and launch `cosmo.exe`.
- **Android ARM64 and x86-64** · Install the [v0.5.0 APK](https://github.com/GITitdoneboi/enhanced-cosmo/releases/download/v0.5.0/cosmo-v0.5.0-android.apk).
- **PlayStation Vita / Vita3K** · Install `cosmo-v0.6.0-vita.vpk`.

The Windows and Android downloads bundle shareware Episode 1. The Windows launcher can also play Episodes 2 and 3 using your own game files. Vita support is experimental; see `vita/README.md` for build and compatibility details.
